name: knob01_position_structure_v2
model_idea: Blind position-only benchmark: race forecast line structure, line seat 1/2/3/4/solo, line size, and number of lines. NO rider performance score, win rate, B/S, style, rider identity, odds, race outcome, or race payout are used in V2 predictions.
model: Empirical event frequencies from previous week, hierarchical smoothing (global to role alpha20, role to role+line_size alpha45, then to role+line_size+line_count_band alpha65). Triplet score = P(first of a) * P(second of b) * P(third of c) * same-line first/second odds factor learned from previous week, clipped 0.7 to 1.4. Choose three highest-rated distinct ordered triples, no results access before predictions fixed.
limitations: Forecast lines are predictions, not confirmed 4th turn geometry.
This cannot measure actual vehicle gaps, fatigue, open running lanes, or per-rider skill; tests structural starting seat effects only.
Position roles in historical results may correlate with skill and race dynamics despite omission of ability indicators.
Three equally weighted tickets are a research benchmark, not a recommended betting scheme.
control: v1 coefficients copied unchanged from original first-week calculation.
